description: Erection of a part first floor rear extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL2/SM/3055 - 01 'Location Plan Block Plan', PL2/SM/3055 - 01 'Existing floor plans', PL2/SM/3055 - 02, PL2/SM/3055 - 03, PL2/SM/3055 - 04 - received 02/10/2020.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No first floor windows shall be provided in the side elevations of the first floor extension hereby approved.
Reason: To safeguard the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers in accordance with Local Plan policy SC7.
